contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Substitute value for every nonoverlapping literal placeholder in template. Do not parse placeholder syntax or expand other placeholders. Dollar signs in value are literal.
contract.domain: Text arguments contain at most 64 Unicode code points each and no lone surrogate code units. Indices and lengths count code points, not UTF-16 units. Inputs are unchanged; returned arrays are fresh. Placeholder is nonempty.

inputRoles.placeholder: nonempty literal placeholder including its delimiters

contract.outputRole: template with every exact placeholder substituted
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
